verdict.rationale: Mailgun shows multi-domain building blocks: Domain Sending Keys are credentials scoped to sending for a single domain, IP pools and dedicated IPs separate sender reputation, and a high-volume community user describes isolating traffic with separate domains and dedicated IPs. Automatic suppression handling is documented, but nothing shows suppressions are kept per domain, and there is no evidence of first-class subaccounts or subusers for tenant isolation. Missing for 10: documented subaccount/subuser feature, per-domain or per-tenant suppression list isolation, per-tenant reputation/stats separation docs, independent corroboration of multi-tenant platform use.
